metadata.selection: First train-array row, chosen before evaluating this checkpoint; not selected by loss or prediction accuracy.
metadata.interpretation: Training-objective illustration for one real prepared training cell and one noise draw, evaluated at a fixed pretrained checkpoint. No parameter updates, optimization history, or inference ODE solve.
metadata.referenceType: Prepared, normalized and causally smoothed training trajectory, including the model's 70% padding floor.
metadata.identityNote: The archive contains no original cell IDs or raw measured lengths. No original identity or raw endpoint is inferred.

capacity.orientation: JSON rows low-to-high voltage, cycle columns; PNG highest-voltage row at top, cycles left-to-right.
capacity.definition: Actual unnormalized cycle-by-voltage discharge-capacity differences relative to cycle 10. Original cycle-11 zeroing and nonfinite treatment retained.

training.lossDefinition: Per-time mean squared error over all 256 normalized coordinates: mean((v_theta(x_t,t,Q)-u_t)^2). This is not optimizer history or an average test error.
training.timeSampling: Actual training samples t uniformly on [0,1]. This explanatory animation sweeps one pair at 101 requested positions t=i/100, aligned with the inference export; no training updates occur.
training.prefixHandling: The first ten x0 coordinates equal the corresponding x1 values; their target and predicted velocities are zero. Full-trajectory loss still averages over 256 coordinates.

normalization.velocityToSohPercentagePointsPerUnitT: v_normalized * sohPercentPerNormalizedUnit; no affine offset is added to velocities.
